reasons: Cited text supports the compliant claim: § 21.1 caps each Party's aggregate liability at the greater of Fees 'paid or payable' by Customer in the 12 months preceding the event and USD 1,000,000, and expressly states the cap is mutual — matching the preferred basis, floor and mutuality.

§ 21.2 mutually excludes indirect/consequential damages ('neither Party') and even deems data-restoration, replacement service, notice and incident-response costs to be direct damages, which is better than the playbook position.

§ 21.3 'Excluded Claims' sits outside the cap and the consequential-damages exclusion and covers every required carve-out (confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, infringement/misappropriation of the other Party's IP), and confirms Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees is not 'damages' — the preferred position in full.

Cap base is not illusory: 'Fees' (§ 1.5) captures recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees; exclusion of a one-time implementation charge is immaterial given the USD 1,000,000 floor.

Consistent with a compliant status, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed and none is needed; deterministic checks (12-month/fixed-floor reference, no unlimited Customer liability) both pass.
